entries.b464047c2d9a9b87: This business manufactures and sells foods such as dressings, sauces, retort foods, frozen foods and soups. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥7,094 million. The main product, Pietro Dressing Wafu Shoyu, is an unheated, raw-type dressing; the majority of sales are made through wholesalers (accounts) to mass merchandisers and supermarkets nationwide. It is manufactured at the factory in Koga City, Fukuoka Prefecture, and consolidated subsidiaries PIETRO NORTH AMERICA, INC. in the United States and GODO KAISHA KONOBEJIFAAMU in Japan each carry out the Products Business in their respective markets.
entries.b79cb7ae6e822601: Under the philosophy of “valuing fans,” the company says it will further strengthen its fan-based management. In the Products Business, it will diversify its businesses, using the dressing category as its earnings base and, in addition to pasta, frozen foods and soup, positioning the Deli and Food Service Business and the Overseas Business as new pillars of growth. In the Store Business, the company says it will enhance the quality of customer experience and roll out area marketing that positions restaurants as experiential brand communication hubs. In addition, production equipment will be relocated and consolidated at a new plant in Koga City, Fukuoka Prefecture, with full-scale operation at the new site scheduled to begin in September 2026, and the mixed-use facility “PIETRO FACTORY PARK,” utilizing the new plant, is scheduled to open in April 2027.

entries.d3761e7ca12ca758: The foundation of its strengths is a structure in which the company combines food manufacturing and sales with restaurant operation, using restaurants as brand communication hubs so that products and stores mutually expand the fan base, together with its commitment to “delicious craftsmanship” through unheated raw-type dressings that preserve the natural qualities of ingredients and small-lot preparation unchanged since its founding.
